blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More than 300 domestic flights in Metro Manila will be rescheduled or canceled ahead of the Asean Summit 2026 next week, the Department of Transportation (DOTr) said Wednesday. Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon said the flight adjustments would accommodate the arrival and departure of foreign delegates and heads of state, with the first arrivals expected on Nov. 14. “We are hosting a major global event, and there will be a major security operation in Metro Manila.
